endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ia_mitchell_interstate_park_cedar_access mitchell-interstate-park-east-end-access-263: The Cedar River Paddling Trips guide publishes this Interstate Park route endpoint coordinate. Mitchell County Conservation currently identifies public water-trail access point 263 at the park's east end. Iowa DNR distinguishes this park access from the below-dam relaunch and says no developed canoe/kayak launch exists downstream of the dam. Retain as an above-dam park/portage access anchor, not a below-dam water-entry point.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (ia_mitchell_interstate_park_cedar_access mitchell-interstate-park-east-end-access-263) on Cedar River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.

endpoints.reach: Halvorson Park to Interstate Park / Mitchell
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: ia_dnr_halvorson_park_concrete_ramp_20260918 iowa-dnr-water-accesses-new-public-68-halvorson-park-ramp: Iowa DNR's public Water Accesses GIS feature identifies Halvorson Park access 268 on the Cedar River, with a concrete 22-by-88-foot ramp, five gravel parking stalls, and parking 70 feet from the access; its point is 43.35390906447915,-92.9227522910695. The Cedar River Water Trail guide places the access just downstream of the Foothill Avenue bridge and says paddlers may find the campground beach about 100 meters upstream easier to enter or exit. Use the DNR point for the mapped ramp; the exact wet toe and the separate beach landing remain unverified.
